What does a Koh Samui jungle safari include? | A shared 4x4 or jeep with a guide, lunch at a hilltop restaurant, drinking water and transfer from the main beach areas. Typical stops are Hin Ta and Hin Yai, Wat Khunaram, Na Muang Waterfall, the Secret Buddha Garden, a viewpoint and the Big Buddha.
How long does the Samui 4x4 safari take? | Seven to eight and a half hours door to door, with pickup from about 08:30 and drop-off around 16:00–17:15, depending on the tour and your hotel.
Are entrance fees included on the jungle safari? | On some tours. The mangrove-kayak, vegan-lunch and elephant-feeding safaris include entry fees; on the ex-army jeep safari you pay about 100 THB at the Secret Buddha Garden, and temple donations are always up to you.
Is the jungle safari suitable for children? | Yes for most children aged 4 and up, with child prices from 800 THB. The open trucks are bumpy and have bench seats rather than child seats, so for toddlers a private minibus tour is the better choice.
Can we swim at Na Muang Waterfall on the safari? | Yes, most safaris stop 45–60 minutes at Na Muang 1, which has a pool below the 18 m fall. The water is fullest from October to January and thin from February to April; the rocks are slippery.
Can I do the safari route myself by scooter? | Mostly. Big Buddha, Wat Plai Laem, Hin Ta and Hin Yai, Wat Khunaram and Na Muang 1 are easy by scooter or car. The Secret Buddha Garden road is very steep and rough, so go there by 4x4 or on a tour.
Is the jungle safari worth doing in the rainy season? | Yes. From October to December the waterfalls are at their fullest and the hills are green; tracks are muddy and operators may skip the steepest section after heavy rain. Bring a light rain jacket.
Do any Koh Samui safari tours include elephant riding? | Not the ones we sell. Five of our shared safaris include no animal activities, and two include an elephant-feeding stop with no riding or bathing. For a dedicated visit, see our ethical elephant sanctuary guide.
How much is a private 4x4 safari on Koh Samui? | A private 4x4 with driver for 8 hours and up to 10 guests costs 9,500 THB, plus 2,500 THB for a guide if you want one. Private versions of our shared safaris start from about 7,500 THB on request.
